title: Gbogbo ayé, gbé Jésù ga
title_en: All Hail the Power of Jesus' Name
review_notes: Transcription matched against photographed TAC pages and a related traditional bilingual hymnal. Diacritics and wording require final orthography review.
verses: Ẹ mú adé Ọba Rẹ wá
Tí ń pè ní pẹpẹ Rẹ
Ẹ kí Ẹni tó gbà yín là
Ẹ tẹ́ k'ogun yín s'ẹsẹ̀ Rẹ
À bá lè pẹ̀lú àwọn t'ọrun
Ká bá lè jọ̀ jùmọ̀ kọrin
verses_en: All hail the power of Jesus' name!
Let angels prostrate fall;
Bring forth the royal diadem,
And crown Him Lord of all.
Crown Him, ye martyrs of our God,
Who from His altar call;
Extol the stem of Jesse's rod,
And crown Him Lord of all.
Ye chosen seed of Israel's race,
Ye ransomed from the fall,
Hail Him who saves you by His grace,
And crown Him Lord of all.
Ye Gentile sinners, ne'er forget
The wormwood and the gall;
Go, spread your trophies at His feet,
And crown Him Lord of all.
Let every kindred, every tribe,
On this terrestrial ball,
To Him all majesty ascribe,
And crown Him Lord of all.
O that with yonder sacred throng
We at His feet may fall,
We'll join the everlasting song,
And crown Him Lord of all.
